vix_vix3m_backwardation.label: VIX BACKWARDATION
vix_vix3m_backwardation.description: VIX/VIX3M ratio crosses below 1.0. When spot VIX exceeds 3-month VIX the term structure inverts (backwardation), signaling panic. Resolution signals fear exhaustion.

skew_tail_risk_resolving.label: SKEW RESOLVING
skew_tail_risk_resolving.description: CBOE SKEW Index was above 130 and drops more than 4% in a single session. High SKEW means institutions are paying elevated premiums for OTM put protection (tail-risk hedging). A sharp SKEW collapse marks the moment that fear premium evaporates — institutional panic is resolved.

bollinger_lower.label: BOLLINGER LOWER
bollinger_lower.description: SPX closes at or below the lower Bollinger Band (20-day SMA − 2σ). Price is statistically extended — more than 2 standard deviations below its 20-day mean. Historical mean-reversion edge.
bollinger_lower.trigger_desc: Daily close ≤ lower BB after being above it

vix_fear_capitulation.label: VIX FEAR CAP
vix_fear_capitulation.description: VIX was above 20 (sustained fear) and drops >5% in a single day. A sharp VIX collapse from elevated levels signals that sellers have exhausted themselves — the fear premium evaporates rapidly.

fib_retracement_bounce.label: FIB BOUNCE
fib_retracement_bounce.description: SPX bounces from a Fibonacci retracement level (38.2%, 50%, or 61.8% of the prior 63-bar swing range). Fib levels act as natural support clusters. Signal confirms: price was at the level yesterday, closes above it today.
fib_retracement_bounce.trigger_desc: Yesterday ±0.3% of fib level, today close > fib level

skew_tail_risk_spike.label: SKEW SPIKE
skew_tail_risk_spike.description: CBOE SKEW Index crosses above 130. SKEW measures the implied cost of OTM put options relative to ATM options. When SKEW crosses above 130, the market is paying a significant premium for tail-risk protection — a surge in institutional demand for downside protection that historically precedes market stabilization.

macd_line_cross.label: MACD CROSS
macd_line_cross.description: MACD line (12-day EMA minus 26-day EMA) crosses above its 9-day signal line. Momentum inflection — the short-term average is accelerating faster than the long-term average, signaling building buy pressure.
macd_line_cross.trigger_desc: MACD line crosses above signal line from below

macd_histogram_pos.label: MACD HIST+
macd_histogram_pos.description: MACD histogram (MACD minus signal) crosses zero from negative to positive. Slightly earlier than the line cross — histogram turning positive means the gap is actively expanding in the bullish direction.
macd_histogram_pos.trigger_desc: Histogram crosses from negative to positive

rsi_cross_40.label: RSI CROSS 40
rsi_cross_40.description: RSI(14) was below 40 (sustained bearish momentum) and crosses back above 40. Catches recovery confirmation — RSI above 40 indicates momentum has shifted from bearish to neutral, often the early stage of a recovery.

obv_divergence.label: OBV DIVERGE
obv_divergence.description: Bullish OBV divergence: SPX makes a 10-day lower low but SPY On-Balance Volume makes a 10-day higher low. Volume pressure is holding up even as price declines — signals institutional accumulation during the selloff.
obv_divergence.trigger_desc: Price 10d lower low + OBV 10d higher low (new crossover)

price_cross_50ma.label: 50MA CROSS
price_cross_50ma.description: SPX daily close crosses above its 50-day simple moving average from below. The 50-day MA is one of the most widely watched medium-term trend indicators. A cross above triggers systematic buying from trend-following funds.

inverse_etf_fear.label: INVERSE ETF FEAR
inverse_etf_fear.description: Inverse ETFs' share of leveraged-plus-inverse ETF dollar volume, summed over 5 days. At 40% or more, traders are crowding into downside bets; Warren Pies uses 40% as a tactical-bottom level. Returns get better the higher it goes, and 45%+ is the strongest zone.
inverse_etf_fear.trigger_desc: Triggered while the 5-day share is ≥40% (strong ≥45%); armed ≥35%

vol_target_washout.label: VOL-TARGET WASHOUT
vol_target_washout.description: Models funds that target 10% volatility: exposure = 10% ÷ the higher of 1-month and 3-month realised volatility, capped at 1.5×. Low exposure means their forced selling has mostly happened. The edge is weak except at the extreme (z below −2).

breadth_washout.label: BREADTH WASHOUT
breadth_washout.description: Share of S&P 500 stocks closing above their 50-day average. At 30% or less the sell-off is broad; the lower it goes, the better the next 30 days have been. Uses today's index members, so stocks that left the index are missing from the history.
breadth_washout.trigger_desc: Triggered while ≤30% of stocks are above their 50-day (strong ≤20%); armed ≤40%
